evals.prompt: Stop the ralph loop, it keeps going in circles on the same failing test.
evals.expected_output: Runs scripts/cancel-ralph.sh once with no arguments and reports its output, for example 'Ralph loop canceled at iteration 4.'. The .ralph folder is deleted. Does not start a new loop or edit code.

evals.prompt: Abort the running Ralph session, I want to take over manually from here.
evals.expected_output: Runs scripts/cancel-ralph.sh and confirms that the loop is canceled, so the stop hook no longer blocks the turn.

evals.prompt: How do I cancel a Ralph loop when I'm using Codex?
evals.expected_output: Triggers ralph-loop-help or answers directly ($cancel-ralph in Codex) without running cancel-ralph.sh, so an active loop keeps running.

evals.prompt: Stop the dev server running on port 3000.
evals.expected_output: Stops the process on port 3000 directly without running cancel-ralph.sh or touching .ralph.
